title: Answer
description:
The leaders named there, and a king, are named so their faith can be owned without the stories being told again. In each case faith did what God had said, against what was seen.

Women received their dead raised to this life again. That return was real, and it was not yet the better resurrection.

Others were tortured and would not accept deliverance, so that they might obtain a better resurrection than a return to this life.

All these obtained a good testimony through faith and did not receive the promise. They are not made perfect apart from those who believe now. It is one people and one promise.
